# AACL Global | Audits and Assurance Consult Ltd

> Audits and Assurance Consult Ltd (AACL Global) is a worldwide security, compliance and ISO consultancy for security printers and suppliers of secure materials, technologies and services, headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya, delivering onsite or remotely.

Important facts:
- Secure products supported: banknotes, passports, ID cards, driving licences, ballot papers, bank and SIM cards, tax stamps, cheques, vouchers, holograms, certificates, security inks, papers, printing plates and security printing software.
- Services: ISO management systems; PCI Card Production (PCI CP); GSMA SAS-UP and SAS-SM; LPS 1175 non-destructive testing of physical security (resistance, delay and response times, security layering, compensating controls); risk assessment; security supplier audits; internal audit; Compliance Support as a Service; training of auditors and implementors.
- AACL is a consultancy, not a certification body. Certificates are issued by accredited certification bodies and scheme owners.
- Industries: security printing, banking and financial services, manufacturing, hospitality, pharmaceuticals, food and beverage, technology, telecommunications, aviation, private security.
- Location: Westlands, Nairobi, Kenya. Phone and WhatsApp: +254 742 139 522. Email: info@aacl.co.ke
